root_cause_or_implementation_gap: The rescue tab existed only as a disabled summary/list boundary: it derived real rescue rows but did not reconcile reference grouping, a dedicated table, real filters, ownership or next-action CTA. FRT-008 now derives counts, priority and filtering from the workspace-scoped Leads and lost-lead-rescue owners, renders a dedicated responsive rescue table, keeps row navigation and archive semantics, and routes Ustaw kolejny krok through the shared TaskCreateDialog.

rules: Rescue membership, severity and next-step state are derived from canonical lost-lead-rescue and lead fields; no screenshot record is hardcoded.
Summary counts, potential, contact cadence, risk, value and owner filters use the current workspace-scoped runtime response; missing forecast and owner data are stated rather than invented.
The reference is used for hierarchy, density and column intent only; current workspace records, counts and labels remain the source of truth.
Row navigation, soft-delete/archive behavior and task creation remain owned by existing route, mutation and ContextActionDialogs/TaskCreateDialog owners; no parallel rescue data model is introduced.
Every visible rescue control is backed by a real query, derived filter, route, existing mutation or existing task dialog; dead decorative actions are not accepted.

visible_controls_wired: All visible rescue controls are backed by current workspace data, canonical rescue classification, derived filters, existing lead navigation, shared TaskCreateDialog task creation or the existing archive mutation; no unsupported import, hard-delete or fabricated action was added.
